text:
sam (PM): quick sync on 'regional routing priority' rollout. Goal: route latency-sensitive EU tenants to local low-latency pool first, then APAC. Need conservative canary + customer opt-in and clear fallback rules.

rachel (eng): flag `regional_routing_v2` with variants `baseline` and `priority_eu`. Scope by region + tenant_tag. Emit header X-Route-Mode and X-Routing-Variant.

omar (sre): constraints: eu capacity bounded during peak. Fallback order: 1) serve quantized local model (soft), 2) route to baseline remote pool, 3) fail closed. Circuit-breaker: p95 > 1s OR error rate +3ppt -> trigger soft-fallback. Auto-kill if fallback_rate > 12% in first 2h.

lee (prod-ops): rollout plan: staging smoke 1h -> internal canary 5% 24h -> EU pilot opt-ins 1% 48h -> ramp 5%->25% over 5 days. Ops owns kill-switch; eng notified. Limit toggles to avoid flapping.

anya (data): eval plan: 6k stratified EU queries + enterprise prompt set. Metrics: embedding-sim delta, hallucination tag rate, latency distribution. Gates: sim >= 0.985 and hallucination <= 1.5x baseline. Save seed at /evals/regional_routing/seed_v3.

sam (PM): telemetry gates: p50 <= 1.12x baseline, p95 <= 1.25x, cost delta < 4%. Also require no regression on pilot customer's keyword task.

rachel (eng): rollout API example: POST /flags/rollout {flag:regional_routing_v2,cohort:eu_pilot,variant:priority_eu,pct:1}. Deploy-bot will start canary and post to #canary-eu-6320001111.

canary-bot: queued: start-canary --flag regional_routing_v2 --cohort eu_internal --pct 5 --dur 24h --notify #canary-eu-6320001111

lee (prod-ops): will assemble opt-in tenant list (pilot: Nimbus) and publish runbook with rollback steps.

omar (sre): monitoring TODOs: synthetic probes, per-tenant dashboards, alert if >5% fallback in 15m.

anya (data): I'll produce baseline numbers and a quality report template by EOD. Privacy signoff required before external pilot.

sam (PM): launch checklist: staging smoke green, internal canary stable 24h, pilot quality gates pass 48h, kill-switch tested. Any gate fail -> abort ramp. Owners: eng (rachel), ops (lee), sre (omar), data (anya).

(ends)
